title: Change of Heart
subject: English
summary: “Change of Heart” is a story about a boy named Prabhat who loves playing sports and always wants to win. He is very competitive and does not like losing. During a sports event, he learns an important lesson about teamwork, friendship and sportsmanship. He realises that winning is not everything and that taking part in games, helping others and enjoying the game are equally important. Slowly, his attitude changes, and he begins to understand the true meaning of sports. The story teaches us that sports are not only about winning but also about teamwork, kindness and fair play.
